            ~&14397210151462632996&~ {

                ~&233721384511543&~ {
                    ~&12826966400293002612&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&12826966400293002612&~
                    ~&3441383163516681764&~: ~&7083038346995&~.~&3441383163516681764&~

                ~&6503823200&~.~&7082646817675&~: "Note mono"
                ~&6504315758&~: ~&7082020628281&~.ingatellentSettings.sleepScreenFolder !== ""
                    ? ~&7082020628281&~.ingatellentSettings.sleepScreenFolder
                    : "All"

                ~&254494525842443467&~ {
                    ~&233721384511543&~.~&6503816592&~: ~&7083038346995&~
                    ~&254542253295368380&~: {
                        var currentFolder = ~&7082020628281&~.ingatellentSettings.sleepScreenFolder;
                        var count = sleepSubdirs.~&214622615378&~;
                        if (count === 0) return;
                        var nextFolder;
                        if (currentFolder === "") {
                            nextFolder = sleepSubdirs.~&197086313&~(0, "fileName");
                        } else {
                            var currentIndex = -1;
                            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                                if (sleepSubdirs.~&197086313&~(i, "fileName") === currentFolder) {
                                    currentIndex = i;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            if (currentIndex === -1 || currentIndex >= count - 1) {
                                nextFolder = "";
                            } else {
                                nextFolder = sleepSubdirs.~&197086313&~(currentIndex + 1, "fileName");
                            }
                        }
                        ~&7082020628281&~.ingatellentSettings.sleepScreenFolder = nextFolder;
                    }
                }
            }
